title: Home Renovation Project Binder
subtitle: Bids, budget, permits, specs and punch list in one place
description: A printable renovation and remodel organizer for homeowners, DIYers and house-flippers. Compare contractor bids, track the budget against actual spend, log permits and inspections, record every paint code, SKU and serial number, and close the project out with a punch list and warranty handover.
previews: Master Budget vs. Actual Cost Tracker
